title: Maximum Tsallis Entropy Distributions for Robust and Efficient Sparse Learning from Correlated Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.17244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper addresses the limitations of Gaussian distribution assumptions in statistical sparse learning, particularly in modeling correlated and heterogeneous data. Conventional Gaussian models often lack robustness towards outliers and underlying distribution assumptions. To overcome these limitations, we propose the use of the $q$Gaussian distribution, derived from Tsallis entropy maximization, as a robust alternative. This is notably relevant in biostatistics, where the presence of correlated observations and heterogeneity, such as in genetic and longitudinal studies, is prevalent. Our contributions include modeling of correlated data through the re-derived multivariate probability density function from Tsallis entropy maximization, thereby addressing the limitations inherent in conventional Gaussian models. translated_title: 最大Tsallis熵分布在相关数据鲁棒高效稀疏学习中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17244v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：本文解决了统计稀疏学习中高斯分布假设的局限性，特别是在建模相关和异质性数据方面。传统高斯模型通常对异常值和潜在分布假设缺乏鲁棒性。为克服这些限制，我们提出使用从Tsallis熵最大化导出的$q$高斯分布作为鲁棒替代方案。这在生物统计学中尤为重要，因为相关观测和异质性（如遗传和纵向研究）普遍存在。我们的贡献包括通过从Tsallis熵最大化重新推导多元概率密度函数来建模相关数据，从而解决传统高斯模型固有的局限性。此外，我们引入了一个新颖框架，将设计用于寻找流中平衡的数值方法适应于解决压缩问题。
tldr: 本文提出用基于Tsallis熵最大化的q高斯分布替代高斯模型，以增强相关和异质数据稀疏学习的鲁棒性，并引入新框架高效解决压缩问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using qGaussian distribution derived from Tsallis entropy maximization to replace Gaussian models, enhancing robustness in sparse learning from correlated and heterogeneous data, and introduces a novel framework for efficient compressed problem solving.
